slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether a customer's demand can be split across vehicles; it only inferred that each customer is served exactly once as a standard VRPTW assumption.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Must every truck that is used start at the depot and return to the depot after completing its last delivery?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trucks must return to the depot, directly covering the hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each customer is visited exactly once and cannot have demand split across multiple vehicles.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent treated single-vehicle-per-customer as a standard VRPTW assumption without asking or confirming it, despite it being a hidden P1 slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1 about split deliveries / single vehicle per customer remained unresolved and was only silently assumed.

summary: The agent recovered the depot-return requirement but failed to ask about whether customer demand can be split across vehicles, silently assuming single-vehicle service and stopping with that P1 slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
